column1: ## Repository Table R7. Ancestry sharing of distinct sequences

## Description: Presence in the listed operational ancestry categories within the assembled corpus. Absence from another sampled category is not population exclusivity. The source field called total distinct loci counts sequence strings in this analysis.
## Missing values: NA means unavailable or not applicable, never a zero score. Numeric values retain source precision.
## Source: Supplementary Table S9; sequence-sharing counts use PC1/PC2-based ancestry annotations.
## Column 1 | Observed ancestry combination | Observed ancestry combination for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 2 | Distinct sequences | Distinct sequences for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 3 | Number of ancestry categories | Number of ancestry categories for the observation defined in the table description.
## Column 4 | Total distinct sequences | Total distinct sequences for the observation defined in the table description.
